name: L1_plan
frozen_before: any L1 dev run (no 11-11..11-27 Lighter/Binance/PM data read in this session before this file was pushed; the 11-25 lighter_flips outputs were read earlier by other sessions)
code: pascal/l1.py on research/pascal-lighter (written after this file; the rules here bind it)

data.lighter: ~/lighter-data/YYYY-MM-DD/{lb,lt,lc}-HH.bin (lighter_rec.py: BTC/ETH 15m, top 3 levels, trades with both account ids, Chainlink 1 s); outcomes ~/lighter-data/lighter_outcomes.csv, else Polymarket winner (pm_winners.csv)
data.binance: shadow_rec.py bn rows, USD-M aggTrade (src 1), BTC/ETH: ~/shadow-rec/DAY or ~/archive/shadow-rec/DAY.tar.zst (extracted one day at a time to a scratch dir, deleted after compaction)
data.polymarket: shadow_rec.py pm rows (15m UP token top of book) for the same asset and window

clock: join in exchange time; view lags at this box: Lighter exch_ms + 2 ms, Binance trade_ms + 4 ms, Polymarket exchange ms + 116 ms

splits.rule: holdout opened once, after frozen/L1_pick.json is pushed; day = UTC day of the window start

L1_D.move: Binance USD-M price change >= 2 bp over the trailing 250 ms (10 ms grid of last trade price, exchange time); onset = first grid time of a run
L1_D.reprice: time from move onset to the next change of Lighter best bid or best ask (exchange time): p10/p50/p90; also split by whether the dominant maker 712772 is at the touch (maker of the last trade at that price) — describe <50 ms vs ~300 ms
L1_D.flow: taker trades split into 'move' (within 500 ms after a Binance >= 2 bp/250 ms move, trade exchange time) and 'quiet' (all others): share of volume; maker-side markout vs Polymarket mid (exchange time) at 1 s, 5 s, 30 s, by taker account (top accounts by volume, others pooled)
L1_D.stop: if quiet-time fills (all makers) do not show a maker markout > 0 at 5 s, stop: L1 is closed and no P&L replay is run

replay.quote: both sides at fair -/+ h, 1¢ ticks (bid down, ask up), post-only (a side that would cross Lighter's book when it lands is not live until the next requote), 30 shares per side (5 shares reported beside)
fair: pm_mid (Polymarket UP mid as seen: exchange + 116 ms)
lighter_mid (Lighter mid as seen: exchange + 2 ms)
replay.requote: when fair seen moves >= 1¢ from the quoted fair: a modify that lands at decision + 2 ms + D
replay.pull_mechanics: Binance signal seen at trade_ms + 4 ms; cancel of both sides lands at seen + 2 ms + D; re-post (at the then-current fair) lands 2 ms after `quiet` seconds without a further signal
replay.D_meaning: 0 = premium (maker/cancel latency 0 ms); 300 = standard (cancel/modify 300 ms); posts always land at + 2 ms
replay.fills: only recorded Lighter taker trades at their match time while our quote is live: improving the displayed best -> a trade at our price or through it fills up to its size; joining (or behind) -> only trades through our price; fill at our price; a filled side is replenished to full size 4 ms after the fill (seen + 2 ms post)
replay.inventory: net position cap 150 shares per window (fills beyond are cut)
replay.settlement: held to settlement (Lighter outcome, else Polymarket winner); maker fee 0
replay.hedge_descriptive: Polymarket taker hedge of each fill at fill + 300 ms (buy the complement at the UP ask/bid then, fee from lp_arb/fees.py): reported, not used for pass
replay.cells: 2 fair x 4 h x (1 'none' + 4 pull x 2 repost) x 2 D x 2 stop = 288 distinct cells per asset at 30 shares (the brief's ~320 counts repost for 'none' too); 5-share results reported beside

validation_before_dev.V1: synthetic: martingale mid with random takers -> P&L ~= spread captured; planted takers arriving 200 ms after Binance moves -> the pull is positive at D = 0 and negative at D = 300 (vs no pull)
validation_before_dev.V2: no pull, D = 300, fair = pm_mid, h = 3¢, posted once per lighter_flips fair3 order (same posting times and lifetimes) reproduces the negative 5 s markout of lighter_flips' fair3 rows within noise; if not, find out why first

metrics_per_cell: markout vs Polymarket mid at 1/5/30 s
share of fills from the top 3 taker accounts
stop_early: if no dev cell at D = 0 has a 5 s markout > 0
dev_pick: highest 90% lower bound (window bootstrap) on ¢/share to settlement among dev cells with 5 s markout > 0 and >= 300 shares/day (30-share quotes); per asset or pooled — one pick, the asset is part of the cell; written to frozen/L1_pick.json and pushed before the holdout is opened
premium_note: if only D = 0 cells pass, the result needs a premium account; P0 found its cost: no fee or stake to switch (binary fees are the bo schedule, maker 0), but each create/modify consumes 1 volume-quota unit earned at $1-2 of fill notional (single cancels are free); report quota needed vs earned
